title: 1960 AHSME Problem 2
statement: It takes \(5\) seconds for a clock to strike \(6\) o’clock beginning at \(6{:}00\) o’clock precisely. If the strikings are uniformly spaced, how long, in seconds, does it take to strike \(12\) o’clock?

solutions.text:
There are \(5\) equal intervals from the first of \(6\) strikes to the last, so each interval lasts \(1\) second. Twelve strikes contain \(11\) such intervals and therefore take \(11\) seconds.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Six strikes contain only five time intervals
Twelve strikes contain eleven intervals of the same length
